name: Shading for Isosurfaces (Single-Pass Multi-Stage)
definition: A single-pass rendering technique for shaded isosurfaces using multi-stage rasterization, eliminating the need for frame buffer copying and allowing colored ambient and diffuse light sources.
summary: This single-pass technique renders shaded isosurfaces using register combiners to compute lighting, eliminating the frame buffer copying required by earlier multi-pass approaches.
